seed.extraction: generate.py executed in-memory with file writes stubbed and action() instrumented to capture guards/updates/lets after its implicit guard injection; st.X[..] references parsed with a bracket-balancing scanner; implicit reads of CallbackArgs/FirstProgressEvent/ProgressRank and @ (old value) added; actor-generic actions split per actor class (Pull/Confirm/Cancel/Budget/Inline/Worker) with short-circuited reads/writes dropped for RefFinalizeReceiverCommit and InvokeCallbackSafely.

summary.candidateCutNote: Placing the receiver-budget pass in PAY_SRC_SETTLE (candidate) makes the shared finalizer engine (_finalize_receiver) span two groups: status/provisional/pending/allDone (receiver-truth claim), fpc/fp/ftodo/fwon/faccepted/fall (Budget finalizer slot, key-partitioned), ops (begin/end op), and all progress-tracker fields become conflicts (26 vs 13).

actions.name: DownloadObjectStart
actions.trigger: send the initial ordinary pull

actions.name: HandleDownloadBegin
actions.trigger: admit a pull while holding the table and operation locks

actions.name: HandleDownloadMissing
actions.trigger: after ref retirement, return retained finished status or missing-ref error; includes a late first acquisition
updates: IF ~st.shutdown /\ st.tombstoneAt >= 0 /\ st.now - st.tombstoneAt <= FinishedRefsTTL THEN (IF st.status[p] = "success" THEN "eof" ELSE "error") ELSE "missing"

actions.name: HandleDownloadMarkActive
actions.trigger: update the sliding global inactivity clock

actions.name: RefSampleReceiverTime
actions.trigger: sample now before acquiring the ref progress lock

actions.name: RefMarkReceiverActive
actions.trigger: publish saved request time under progress lock after any lock wait

actions.name: TransactionMarkReceiverActive
actions.trigger: publish the same captured time under transaction stats lock

actions.name: HandleDownloadActiveProgress
actions.trigger: request ACTIVE progress before produce

actions.name: HandleDownloadProduce
actions.trigger: ordinary produce returns DATA then EOF; transport contents abstracted

actions.name: HandleDownloadProduceException
actions.trigger: ordinary produce exception prepares FAILED progress and PROCESS_EXCEPTION

actions.name: RefObjServed
actions.trigger: record a provisional serve or return no nonce when already final
updates: IF st.status[p] = "none" THEN (IF st.rc[p] = "eof" THEN "success" ELSE "failed") ELSE "none"

actions.name: HandleDownloadTerminalProgress
actions.trigger: choose progress from returned serve nonce and producer RC, outside progress lock
updates: RequestPub(p, IF st.nonce[p] THEN "active" ELSE IF st.rc[p] = "eof" THEN "completed" ELSE "failed", 0, TRUE)

actions.name: HandleDownloadDataProgress
actions.trigger: count one abstract data unit and prepare ACTIVE progress

actions.name: HandleDownloadEndOp
actions.trigger: finally leaves the operation gate before the reply becomes receivable

actions.name: ConsumerReceiveData
actions.trigger: receive DATA and remember cancel capability; one unit consumed next

actions.name: ConsumerLaunchPipeline
actions.trigger: submit next request BEFORE calling consume on the current data

actions.name: ConsumerConsumeReturn
actions.trigger: value-stable consume returns; wait for the already submitted request

actions.name: ConsumerConsumeException
actions.trigger: consume raises; cancel an unstarted future, but an admitted request keeps running

actions.name: ConsumerReceiveEOF
actions.trigger: receive EOF and enter download_completed before sending any confirmation

actions.name: ConsumerDownloadCompleted
actions.trigger: download_completed returns successfully

actions.name: ConsumerDownloadCompletedException
actions.trigger: download_completed raises and schedules FAILED confirmation

actions.name: ConsumerSendConfirm
actions.trigger: send receiver truth only if terminal reply requested nonce-bound confirmation

actions.name: ConsumerReceiveError
actions.trigger: ordinary failed request causes cancellation after acquisition

actions.name: LoseConfirmation
actions.trigger: best-effort confirmation fails to arrive; receiver budgets remain the backstop
actions.envDriver: NVNetwork: drop of RECEIVER_CONFIRM in flight

actions.name: HandleConfirmBegin
actions.trigger: admit confirmation, preserving nonce requirement for the later final-status lock

actions.name: HandleConfirmLate
actions.trigger: drop confirmation after retirement/closed gate

actions.name: HandleCancelBegin
actions.trigger: admit cancellation before testing transaction-level acquisition

actions.name: HandleCancelLate
actions.trigger: drop cancellation after retirement/closed gate

actions.name: HandleCancelAcquired
actions.trigger: snapshot acquired membership, then iterate all fixed sibling refs
updates: IF c \in st.acquired THEN {<<r,c>> : r \in Refs} ELSE {}

actions.name: FinalizerSelectRef
actions.trigger: select the next ref before acquiring its progress lock

actions.name: RefFinalizeReceiverCommit
actions.trigger: atomic dedup, pending guard, pop, status record and downloaded_to_all latch
actions.lets:
p == st.fp[t]
value == IF t \in Confirmers THEN st.consumerResult[p] ELSE "failed"
won == st.status[p] = "none" /\ (t \notin Confirmers \/ (st.pending[p] /\ st.consumerNonce[p]))
m == IF won THEN [st.status EXCEPT ![p] = value] ELSE st.status
all == won /\ ~st.allDone[p[1]] /\ RefFinished(m, p[1])
updates: IF won THEN Callback("one", p[1]) ELSE @

actions.name: RefDownloadedToOneReturned
actions.trigger: after guarded downloaded_to_one, independently invoke downloaded_to_all if latched
updates: IF st.fall[t] THEN Callback("all", st.fp[t][1]) ELSE EmptyCB

actions.name: RefDownloadedToAllReturned
actions.trigger: guarded downloaded_to_all returns to the caller

actions.name: RefFinalizerProgress
actions.trigger: after callback return select receiver truth for progress (separate from final commit)
updates: RequestPub(st.fp[t], IF st.status[st.fp[t]] = "success" THEN "completed" ELSE "failed", 0, TRUE)

actions.name: FinalizerAdvance
actions.trigger: after receiver publication return to the sibling/candidate loop

actions.name: HandleConfirmMarkActive
actions.trigger: accepted confirmation refreshes transaction clock only, after its callbacks

actions.name: HandleCancelLoopDone
actions.trigger: all sibling cancellation attempts returned

actions.name: FinalizerEndOp
actions.trigger: end operation BEFORE requesting finish-if-complete

actions.name: MonitorBegin
actions.trigger: capture monitor time before budget operations; no absolute transaction-age deadline

actions.name: MonitorAdmitBudgets
actions.trigger: register budget pass as an operation if the transaction is still live

actions.name: EnforceReceiverBudgetsSnapshot
actions.trigger: capture receiver activity once per transaction budget pass under stats lock

actions.name: RefEnforceBudgetSnapshot
actions.trigger: copy final receiver identities under this ref lock before constructing its full failures list

actions.name: RefEnforceBudgetCandidate
actions.trigger: one actual candidate decision appends to the saved list before any enforcement
actions.lets:
last == st.budgetLast[c]
eligible == c \notin st.budgetFinal /\
    IF last = -1 THEN AcquireTimeout > 0 /\ st.budgetNow > AcquireTimeout
    ELSE IdleTimeout > 0 /\ st.budgetNow - last > IdleTimeout
updates: IF eligible THEN Append(@, c) ELSE @

actions.name: RefEnforceBudgetBuildDone
actions.trigger: the complete failure list now exists; enforcement starts in its saved order

actions.name: RefEnforceBudgetSelect
actions.trigger: select the head of the already constructed failure list without rereading final truth

actions.name: RefEnforceBudgetRecheck
actions.trigger: freshness recheck under stats lock; release it BEFORE final-status commit

actions.name: RefEnforceBudgetRefDone
actions.trigger: finish this saved failure list before snapshotting the next ref

actions.name: MonitorBudgetEndOp
actions.trigger: finish all per-ref budget passes and leave operation gate before classification

actions.name: MonitorClassifyBegin
actions.trigger: hold the table lock across classification and retirement; admitted finalizers may still progress

actions.name: MonitorSampleFinished
actions.trigger: save the is_finished result at its monotone status scan boundary

actions.name: MonitorSampleTimeout
actions.trigger: compare sampled monitor time with current global activity after the earlier negative finish test
updates: IF st.monitorNow - st.txLast > TxTimeout THEN "timeout" ELSE "keep"

actions.name: MonitorNoRetirement
actions.trigger: classification has saved a keep decision or found the transaction absent

actions.name: MonitorClassifyEnd
actions.trigger: release the table lock before receipt expiry and callbacks

actions.name: FinishTransactionIfComplete
actions.trigger: table-locked single-winner retirement; monotone final-status scan linearizes at successful check

actions.name: FinishTransactionNotComplete
actions.trigger: helper observes missing transaction or a ref that is not complete

actions.name: MonitorRetireFinished
actions.trigger: monitor retires using its saved finished classification and schedules its own inline settlement

actions.name: MonitorRetireTimeout
actions.trigger: retire using the saved timeout classification even if an admitted finalizer completed meanwhile

actions.name: DeleteTransaction
actions.trigger: explicit deletion atomically wins table ownership, then runs settlement outside the lock

actions.name: Shutdown
actions.trigger: atomically clear ownership and receipts; resolve pending waiters with None BEFORE cleanup
actions.envDriver: CJ job exit / DownloadService.shutdown in the CJ process

actions.name: RefMakeProgressEvent
actions.trigger: construct or suppress a progress event atomically, latching first terminal state
actions.lets:
p == st.pub[t].pair
wasTerminal == st.progressTerminal[p] # "none"
override == st.refTerminal[p[1]] # "none" /\ st.pub[t].want \notin TerminalStates
state == IF override THEN st.refTerminal[p[1]] ELSE st.pub[t].want
delta == IF override THEN 0 ELSE st.pub[t].delta
bytes == st.progressBytes[p] + delta
emit == ~wasTerminal /\ (override \/ st.pub[t].force \/ p \notin st.progressStarted \/ state \in TerminalStates \/ delta > 0)
updates: IF p \notin st.progressStarted THEN Append(@, p[2]) ELSE @
IF emit /\ state \in TerminalStates THEN state ELSE @
IF emit THEN {Event(p, state, st.progressSeq[p]+1, bytes)} ELSE {}

actions.name: TransactionEmitProgressEvent
actions.trigger: invoke public source progress callback after releasing progress lock
updates: IF e.state \in TerminalStates THEN e.state ELSE @

actions.name: TransactionProgressCallbackReturn
actions.trigger: progress callback returns or its ordinary Exception is contained; no unmodeled callback mutation

actions.name: CheckedExecutorEnqueue
actions.trigger: enqueue settlement before submission acknowledgement (brief S3; saved stdlib evidence)

actions.name: CheckedExecutorSubmitReturn
actions.trigger: return the Future; the worker may already have started

actions.name: CheckedExecutorSubmitRuntimeError
actions.trigger: post-enqueue non-shutdown RuntimeError propagates; DownloadService selects fallback without dequeuing

actions.name: CheckedExecutorSubmitStopped
actions.trigger: executor declines submission before enqueue and returns None

actions.name: SubmitFinishedSettlementFallback
actions.trigger: run inline fallback through the same finished-settlement claim as queued work

actions.name: SettleFinishedTransactionWorker
actions.trigger: a runnable worker dequeues the existing settlement item, even if submission reported error

actions.name: SettleFinishedTransactionClaim
actions.trigger: claim FINISHED settlement exactly once under the table lock, then release it

actions.name: SettleFinishedTransactionReject
actions.trigger: queued or inline duplicate returns before drain, callbacks, release or recording

actions.name: TransactionDoneSampleDeadline
actions.trigger: sample the deadline before acquiring the operation condition lock

actions.name: TransactionDoneDrainBegin
actions.trigger: close gate under operation lock using the previously sampled deadline

actions.name: TransactionDoneDrainEmpty
actions.trigger: drain returns normally once all admitted operations ended

actions.name: TransactionDoneDrainExpired
actions.trigger: after the bounded wait, proceed even with outstanding operations

actions.name: TransactionDoneSnapshotRef
actions.trigger: copy one complete per-ref status map under that ref lock; refs are snapshotted separately
updates: [p \in Pairs |-> IF p[1] = r THEN st.status[p] ELSE st.snapshots[t][p]]

actions.name: TransactionDoneComputeOutcome
actions.trigger: compute strict success and common-receiver quorum from the frozen matrix

actions.name: TransactionDoneComputeException
actions.trigger: contained computation Exception creates an empty fail-closed verdict and still executes cleanup

actions.name: TransactionDoneTerminalProgress
actions.trigger: under one ref lock, set ref-wide terminal override and construct all started-receiver events
actions.lets:
state == DoneProgress(st.cause)
eligible == {p \in st.progressStarted : p[1] = r /\ st.progressTerminal[p] = "none"}
updates: [p \in Pairs |-> IF p \in eligible THEN state ELSE st.progressTerminal[p]]
[p \in Pairs |-> st.progressSeq[p] + IF p \in eligible THEN 1 ELSE 0]
[EmptyPub EXCEPT !.pc = IF eligible = {} THEN "idle" ELSE "call", !.events = {Event(p, state, st.progressSeq[p]+1, st.progressBytes[p]) : p \in eligible}]

actions.name: TransactionDoneProgressReturned
actions.trigger: finish terminal progress callbacks before capturing the base objects

actions.name: TransactionDoneSnapshotBaseObject
actions.trigger: snapshot each infrastructure source reference before object callbacks; another settlement may already release it

actions.name: TransactionDoneObjectsBegin
actions.trigger: begin per-object transaction_done callback loop

actions.name: TransactionDoneObjectCallback
actions.trigger: prepare one guarded object transaction_done callback

actions.name: TransactionDoneObjectReturned
actions.trigger: return to loop after this object hook returned or raised

actions.name: TransactionDoneTransactionCallback
actions.trigger: invoke configured transaction_done_cb with this invocation's base-object snapshot

actions.name: TransactionDoneOutcomeCallback
actions.trigger: after transaction callback return, invoke outcome_cb BEFORE source releases

actions.name: TransactionDoneReleaseBegin
actions.trigger: finally begins release loop despite guarded callback Exceptions

actions.name: TransactionDoneRelease
actions.trigger: prepare each independently guarded release attempt

actions.name: TransactionDoneReleaseReturned
actions.trigger: continue release loop after this source release returned or raised

actions.name: InvokeCallbackSafely
actions.trigger: enter user hook; observer counts invocations/attempts, independently of return or exception
updates: IF k = "objectDone" THEN [st.objectDoneCalls EXCEPT ![r] = @ + 1] ELSE st.objectDoneCalls
IF k = "release" THEN [st.releaseAttempts EXCEPT ![r] = @ + 1] ELSE st.releaseAttempts

actions.name: ReleaseSourceReference
actions.trigger: owned-source release drops only the infrastructure reference, before its hook returns
actions.envDriver: NVObjects: drops one infrastructure reference of the backing object

actions.name: CallbackReturn
actions.trigger: finite callback returns; no caller phase advances until this return

actions.name: CallbackException
actions.trigger: ordinary callback/release Exception is contained; already visible effects are not undone

actions.name: TransactionDoneRecordReady
actions.trigger: all this invocation's release attempts have returned before on_outcome recording

actions.name: RecordOutcome
actions.trigger: owner-guarded single receipt write; resolve pending waiters atomically with recording

actions.name: RecordOutcomeDrop
actions.trigger: ownership consumed by another record or cleared by shutdown: discard duplicate receipt

actions.name: TransactionDoneComplete
actions.trigger: set settlement_complete after recording returns; this is not an entry latch

actions.name: SyncTerminationMarkerRead
actions.trigger: snapshot whether admitted operations remain under operation lock

actions.name: SyncTerminationMarkerWrite
actions.trigger: sustain or clear marker under table lock using sampled operation state

actions.name: ReapTerminationMarker
actions.trigger: monitor removes a quiescent marker; remaining settlement duplication is not counted by this latch

actions.name: ExpireOutcome
actions.trigger: remove retained receipt after strict greater-than TTL; previously resolved waiters retain their value

actions.name: GetTransferWaiter
actions.trigger: attach a second observer; unswept expired receipt still resolves it, exactly as current API
updates: IF st.retained THEN "receipt" ELSE IF st.owner THEN "pending" ELSE "none"
IF st.retained THEN st.receipt ELSE EmptyVerdict

actions.name: WaitForResultTransfers
actions.trigger: minimal caller barrier: only a non-None strict COMPLETED receipt permits success

actions.name: AdvanceTime
actions.trigger: advance abstract monotone wall time; monitor execution remains independent

actions.name: HandleDownloadProduceError
actions.trigger: produce returns ERROR as an ordinary functional outcome, provisionally awaiting receiver truth

actions.name: ConsumerReceiveProducerError
actions.trigger: terminal ERROR carries nonce; prepare FAILED confirmation without download_completed

actions.name: DownloadRequestWorkerStart
actions.trigger: the submitted pipeline future starts before remote admission; cancel can no longer erase the request

actions.name: SourceDownloadRegister
actions.trigger: register an actual receiver attempt and atomically consume a cached source failure

actions.name: SourceDownloadEnter
actions.trigger: pass the initial source-cancellation check and enter the real download loop

actions.name: SourceFailureNotify
actions.trigger: cache an owned source failure and trigger only untriggered registered signals under one lock
actions.envDriver: source owner (CJ external-process backend _fail_accepted_result_source -> notify_source_failure) sends SOURCE_FAILURE to SJ
updates: [p \in Pairs |-> IF p \in st.sourceRegistered /\ p[1] \in rs /\ st.sourceSignal[p] = "none" THEN "failed" ELSE st.sourceSignal[p]]

actions.name: ShutdownSourceDownloads
actions.trigger: publish typed local cancellation without overwriting earlier failure; clear registry under source failure lock
actions.envDriver: SJ job exit / DownloadService.shutdown in the SJ process (seed triggers it from CJ Shutdown via shutdownSourcesPending)
updates: [p \in Pairs |-> IF p \in st.sourceRegistered /\ st.sourceSignal[p] = "none" THEN "cancelled" ELSE st.sourceSignal[p]]

actions.name: ConsumerSourceAbortBegin
actions.trigger: observe the actual saved abort reason and begin consumer notification; preserve admitted pipeline work

actions.name: ConsumerSourceAbortNotified
actions.trigger: actual consumer.download_failed returns before local cancellation propagation

actions.name: ConsumerSourceAbortExit
actions.trigger: typed local cancellation escapes; an owned-source failure follows the ordinary notified return path

actions.name: SourceDownloadUnregister
actions.trigger: finally removes the same signal even when DownloadCancelled or consumer completion raises

callbackErrors.note: Contained-exception counter incremented by CallbackException of any actor; no guard reads it. Split per group or drop.

cancelWire.note: CANCEL channel SJ->CJ (set of receivers, no ref): RCV sends, SERVE consumes (Begin/Late).

cb.note: Indexed by actor t; finalizer slots (SERVE) and settler slots (SETTLE) are disjoint.

closed.note: Operation gate closed by TransactionDoneDrainBegin; SERVE begin_op atomically checks it while adding to ops.

confirmWire.note: CONFIRM channel SJ->CJ (set of pairs): RCV sends, SERVE consumes (Begin/Late), ENV_NET drops (LoseConfirmation).

consumerNonce.note: SJ copy of serve nonce; read by RefFinalizeReceiverCommit[Confirm] as CONFIRM nonce.

consumerResult.note: SJ receiver truth; read by RefFinalizeReceiverCommit[Confirm] as the CONFIRM status.

finishReady.note: In-process call: finalizer thread (SERVE) requests _finish_transaction_if_complete; SETTLE actions consume. Producer/consumer mailbox, no lost-update risk.

futureStarted.note: SJ request-future started; CJ HandleDownloadBegin/Missing require it (PULL actually transmitted).

index.note: SJ consumed-chunk count; CJ HandleDownloadProduce uses it as the request state (DATA vs EOF).

live.note: Transaction-table membership. SETTLE retires (Finish/MonitorRetire/Delete/Shutdown); SERVE admission (Begin vs Late/Missing) and budget admission read it.

monitorNow.note: Monitor iteration time sample handed to the budget pass (call parameter).

monitorPC.note: Monitor thread control token: SETTLE owns idle/classify..settling, SERVE owns admit->budget->classify. Mutually exclusive by PC value; replace by budget-pass call/return port.

observedTerminal.note: Progress observer latch per pair written by every actor's TransactionEmitProgressEvent; read only by CompletedProgressHasReceiverSuccess. Keep as a shared observer/history variable or split by emitting group.

ops.note: Admitted operations (pulls, confirm/cancel finalizers, budget pass). SETTLE drain/marker read it. Monotone semantics: ops admitted before close may still end after close.

progressBytes.note: Progress tracker byte counters copied into terminal events.

progressOrder.note: Progress tracker insertion order used by FirstProgressEvent when settlers emit batch terminal events.

progressSeq.note: Per-ref _progress_lock state: RefMakeProgressEvent (pull/finalizer/budget) and TransactionDoneTerminalProgress (settler) both increment. Real conflict; resolve by moving the terminal-progress apply step into SERVE behind a request/ack port.

progressStarted.note: Progress tracker: receivers with started progress (read by terminal-progress emission).

progressTerminal.note: Terminal latch (MC-2 locus): first terminal progress per pair wins. Written by RefMakeProgressEvent (SERVE) and TransactionDoneTerminalProgress (SETTLE). Same resolution as progressSeq.

pub.note: Indexed by actor t; SERVE writes pub[Pull(p)], pub[Confirm/Cancel/Budget]; SETTLE writes pub[Inline/Worker]. No shared key: split per group.

pullPC.note: One per-pair slot multiplexes SJ request lifecycle (idle/sent/done, retract of an unstarted future), the PULL in flight (sent & futureStarted) and the CJ handler thread PC (markTx..end). Split into rcvReqPC[p] (RCV), PULL/REPLY messages and handlerPC[req] (SERVE).

refTerminal.note: Ref-wide terminal override set by settlement terminal progress; read by later RefMakeProgressEvent (late pulls/finalizers).

reply.note: One-slot REPLY channel CJ->SJ: written by HandleDownloadEndOp/Missing, consumed (cleared) by Consumer* and ConsumerSourceAbortBegin(where=reply).

replyNonce.note: Wire: serve nonce attached to terminal REPLY.

shutdown.note: CJ service shut down: finished-ref tombstones cleared (HandleDownloadMissing replies "missing").

shutdownSourcesPending.note: Continuation flag of ONE process's DownloadService.shutdown: CJ table teardown (Shutdown) triggers SJ-side ShutdownSourceDownloads. Physically two independent per-process shutdowns; delete the flag in the split.

status.note: Receiver-truth matrix. Monotone none->final, immutable afterwards (FinalStatusesImmutable). Read by monitor finish sample, finish-if-complete scan, per-ref settlement snapshot.

tableLocked.note: Table lock held by the monitor across classify..retire. SERVE handlers block on it (guard ~tableLocked). Lock owned by one group only.

tombstoneAt.note: Finished-ref tombstone time set on FINISHED retirement. NOTE: seed pairs it with LIVE status[p]; source stores a receiver-status snapshot at unlink (_FinishedRef). In a split, SETTLE should export the snapshot, not let SERVE read live status.

txLast.note: Sliding transaction activity time (pulls, accepted confirm). Read by MonitorSampleTimeout.

waiter.note: TransferWaiter resolution (receipt/none) read by caller barrier.

waiterOutcome.note: TransferWaiter value read by caller barrier.

PAY_RCV.summary: Receiver/consumer side: download_object + _download_object (pull pipeline, EOF, download_completed/failed, confirm/cancel send) and the SJ-side owned-source signal registry (_register/_unregister_source_download, _handle_source_failure, SJ shutdown cancellation).
mechanismsKept: source-failure lock: register vs source-failure publish vs shutdown cancel, first cause latched (handoff #2, SourceCauseImmutable)
pipeline: next PULL launched before consume; unstarted future can be cancelled, admitted request cannot (MC-2 trigger side)
abort path: CANCEL send -> download_failed -> typed DownloadCancelled vs ordinary return (LocalCancellationNotified)

sends: PULL(tx, ref=p[1], receiver=p[2], reqSeq, state=index[p]) at DownloadObjectStart (sync) / DownloadRequestWorkerStart (pipelined)
CONFIRM(ref, receiver, status=consumerResult[p], nonce) at ConsumerSendConfirm, only when the terminal REPLY carried a nonce
CANCEL(ref, receiver) at ConsumerConsumeException (always), ConsumerReceiveError (index>0), ConsumerSourceAbortBegin (canCancel); no nonce
consumes: SOURCE_FAILURE(source_fqcn, ref_ids, reason) from the source owner's parent (SourceFailureNotify)
SJ_SHUTDOWN (local DownloadService.shutdown of the SJ process; today driven by CJ Shutdown via shutdownSourcesPending)
DOWNLOAD_START(descriptor) from the SJ workflow/FOBS decode (implicit today: all pairs enabled at Init)
reads: none after re-encoding (today: pullPC, reply, replyNonce, shutdownSourcesPending)

coarseObligations: Per pair: >=1 DATA PULL then an EOF PULL; the next PULL may be in flight/admitted at the source while the consumer still consumes, so a CANCEL can be sent while a PULL is admitted (needed to keep MC-2 reachable).
CONFIRM only after a terminal REPLY that carried a nonce; CONFIRM(success) only after materialization (ConfirmedSuccess spans RCV/SERVE).

Failure outcomes: consume exception -> CANCEL, no CONFIRM; download_completed exception -> CONFIRM(failed); ERROR reply -> CONFIRM(failed) without materialization; PROCESS_EXCEPTION/MISSING -> CANCEL iff index>0; source failure / SJ shutdown -> CANCEL iff canCancel, download_failed before exit, typed cancelled vs returned.
Silence remains possible: never pull, stop mid-stream, or lose CONFIRM (budgets/timeouts are the source-side backstop).
At most one outstanding PULL per pair (seed restriction; real retries/max_retries belong to NVNetwork).

PAY_SRC_SERVE.summary: Source serving side: _handle_download (pull admission, activity marks, produce, obj_served provisional nonce, progress, end_op), _handle_confirm/_handle_cancel, the shared _finalize_receiver engine with downloaded_to_one/all, the monitor's receiver-budget pass (enforce_receiver_budgets / enforce_budgets), and the per-ref progress tracker with progress_cb.
mechanismsKept: receiver-truth claim/dedup in _finalize_receiver: confirm vs cancel vs budget finalizers race on status[p] (first final wins, pending/nonce guard, downloaded_to_all latch)
provisional serve (obj_served) vs final status: EOF stays provisional until nonce-bound confirm (handoff #5)
budget snapshot -> complete ordered failure list -> recheck activity -> finalize (handoff #3) against concurrent pull activity marks and confirm commits
progress tracker terminal latch: cancel FAILED vs admitted EOF COMPLETED (MC-2, REPRODUCED known behavior)
operation gate begin_op/end_op for pulls, finalizers and the budget pass

sends: REPLY(inReplyTo, rc, nonce iff status[p]="none" at obj_served)
FINISH_IF_COMPLETE(t) (in-process call, finishReady) after end_op of an accepted finalization
consumes: BUDGET_PASS(monitorNow) from the SETTLE monitor loop
TERMINAL_PROGRESS(ref, state) request from settlement (recommended refactor of TransactionDoneTerminalProgress)
reads: shutdown, tombstoneAt (+ finished receiver-status snapshot) for MISSING/EOF/ERROR replies to late PULLs

coarseObligations: status[p]: single atomic commit per pair, first wins, immutable; success only from an accepted CONFIRM(success) matching the pending serve nonce; failed via CONFIRM(failed), CANCEL (acquired receivers, all sibling refs), acquire-timeout (never acquired) or idle budget.
Operations admitted before closed may finish after retirement/close: late status commits, late progress, late end_op (drain leak, TIMEOUT-then-complete -> COMPLETED with TIMEOUT cause).
Late messages: CONFIRM/CANCEL after retirement are dropped; PULL after retirement -> MISSING, or EOF/ERROR from the finished-ref tombstone within FinishedRefsTTL (not after shutdown).
REPLY failure kinds: PROCESS_EXCEPTION (produce raised), ERROR (functional), MISSING; nonce only on terminal EOF/ERROR when status still none.
txLast refreshed by pulls and accepted confirms only; finishReady only after an accepted finalization.
Progress observations may contradict final status (COMPLETED after FAILED, MC-2); a coarse variant that drops progress must state that CompletedProgressHasReceiverSuccess is no longer checkable.

PAY_SRC_SETTLE.summary: Source settlement side: monitor classification/retirement (_monitor_tx), finish-if-complete, delete, CJ service shutdown, checked executor submission and inline fallback, finished-settlement claim, transaction_done (drain, per-ref snapshot, outcome, terminal progress, base objects, object/tx/outcome callbacks, releases), owner-guarded receipt recording, waiters, termination marker, receipt TTL.
mechanismsKept: retirement single winner under the table lock: saved monitor FINISHED/TIMEOUT decision vs finalizer finish-if-complete vs delete vs shutdown (handoff #4)
finished-settlement claim: queued worker vs inline fallback after post-enqueue RuntimeError (MC-1, fixed in scope; handoff #1)
drain with sampled deadline; forced drain leaves ops outstanding
receipt ownership: single record, shutdown clears owner and resolves waiters with None first; late waiter; TTL expiry
callback/release ordering: transaction_done -> outcome_cb -> releases -> record -> settlement_complete -> marker

sends: transaction_done_cb(tx, cause, sources), object transaction_done(ref), outcome_cb(verdict)
waiter resolution (receipt | None) to TransferWaiter holders
exposes: live, closed, tableLocked, shutdown, tombstoneAt(+status snapshot), refTerminal, monitorNow
reads: status (finish sample, finish scan, per-ref snapshot)

coarseObligations: Exactly one retirement with cause in {finished, timeout, deleted}; closed only after retirement; a TIMEOUT decision may retire a transaction that becomes complete before the snapshot (strict outcome COMPLETED, cause timeout).

Verdict from frozen per-ref snapshots taken after drain (possibly forced with ops outstanding): completed iff all pairs success in the snapshot; deleted -> aborted; else failed (timeout/receiver_failed); compute exception -> failed/computation_failed with empty matrix.

At most one effect chain (claim) even when the worker and inline fallback both run; release attempted for every ref even after callback exceptions; outcome_cb before releases; record after all own releases.

Receipt at most once and owner-guarded; shutdown resolves pending waiters with None before cleanup and drops later records; receipt expires after ReceiptTTL; a late waiter sees retained receipt, pending, or None.
Caller-visible success only for a non-None COMPLETED receipt (CallerRequiresCompleted).

ENV_NET.summary: network fault on CONFIRM (LoseConfirmation); becomes NVNetwork

wire.seedEncoding: pullPC[p]="sent" /\ futureStarted[p] (in flight); content index[p] read by reference

environment.integrate: Add a SETTLE- or new PAY_SRC_REG-owned registration action under table/outcome locks; keep RegisteredInit as a mix option.
Waiter creation becomes a caller action; WaitForResultTransfers moves to the trainer component.

environment.stands_for: RESULT_ENVELOPE receipt and FOBS decode calling download_object per ref
environment.integrate: Guard RCV start on a DOWNLOAD_START(descriptor) port input.

environment.neighbor: SJ result materialization = VS MaterializeResult; workflow acceptance is separate
environment.integrate: Expose consumerResult/consumer terminal as RCV port outputs.

environment.integrate: Producer faults stay SERVE-local faults; object identity from NVObjects.

environment.integrate: Hooks become port outputs; ReleaseSourceReference writes object state.

environment.integrate: Become a network message consumed by RCV.

properties.name: ConfirmedSuccess
properties.note: Cross-process: SERVE status vs RCV consumerResult; becomes the CONFIRM-content obligation on the RCV port.

properties.name: CompletedProgressHasReceiverSuccess
properties.note: observedTerminal is written by SERVE and SETTLE emitters; SERVE-local once terminal progress apply moves to SERVE.

properties.name: EventualSettlementObservation
properties.note: Liveness of SETTLE, but needs SERVE ops to end (or drain expiry via time) and fairness of SERVE/RCV-free steps.

properties.name: MonitorLockOwnership
properties.note: monitorPC is a thread token shared with the SERVE budget pass under the proposed cut.

properties.name: MessageCount
properties.note: The seed's own wire census: confirmWire + cancelWire + pullPC="sent" + reply # none.

properties.name: Symmetry
properties.note: Permutations(Receivers) must be applied consistently across all groups of a mix.

properties.name: Abs / Refinement
properties.note: acquired, confirmed <- SERVE (acquired, status); materialized, confirmSent <- RCV (consumerResult, consumer); retired, released, outcome, settled <- SETTLE (live, sourceHeld, receipt, settlementComplete). Success-only FineNext.

hardProblems: pullPC multiplexes the SJ request lifecycle, the PULL in flight (with futureStarted) and the CJ handler PC; reply is a single slot. Re-encoding as PULL/REPLY messages plus per-side PCs must keep pipelining (next PULL before consume) and "admitted request survives cancel".

Message contents are read by reference at processing time (index, consumerResult, consumerNonce); sound only under one-outstanding-request and frozen-after-send arguments, and nonces are booleans. Ports must carry values.

shutdownSourcesPending couples two processes' shutdowns (an artifact of the single-process trace harness). Traces that contain shutdown or source-failure orderings encode this coupling, so per-mix replay of them needs an adapter that emits both shutdown events.

Progress tracker (_progress_lock state: progressSeq/progressTerminal/refTerminal) is written by SERVE pull/finalizer actors and by SETTLE TransactionDoneTerminalProgress; MC-2 lives here. Needs a request/ack refactor so the tracker is SERVE-private.

Receiver-budget pass must sit with confirm/cancel finalizers (shared _finalize_receiver dedup + activity snapshot/recheck). The candidate cut (budget in SETTLE) yields 26 conflict fields vs 13; the monitor thread then spans SERVE and SETTLE (monitorPC token).

Retirement/drain gates (live/closed/tableLocked/ops) are narrow ports but carry the bug-prone timing: admitted ops outlive close, a saved TIMEOUT decision retires a now-complete tx. A coarse SERVE/SETTLE must keep these late interleavings.
Six actor-generic actions (progress/callback) need instance-level splitting by actor class; observer counters (callbackErrors, observedTerminal) and the global TypeOK/Symmetry are shared.
ConfirmedSuccess (status => consumerResult) and the refinement mapping Abs span RCV and SERVE/SETTLE; they become port-level obligations.

HandleDownloadMissing pairs tombstoneAt with LIVE status[p]; the source returns a receiver-status snapshot taken at unlink. The split should export the snapshot from SETTLE (possible seed shortcut, not verified by a trace).
